title: Base64 encode / decode
description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 to text. Runs entirely in the browser — no data leaves your machine.

title: JSON formatter
description: Pretty-print or minify JSON. Validate and format in the browser with copy-to-clipboard.

title: UUID generator
description: Generate random UUIDs (v4). Pick how many, copy one or all. Uses crypto.randomUUID.

title: URL encode / decode
description: Encode text for URLs (query params) or decode percent-encoded strings.

title: CSV → JSON converter
description: Normalize DynamoDB-style exports, type booleans/numbers, flatten maps, emit pretty JSON.

title: Markdown preview
description: Type Markdown and see rendered HTML in real time. Powered by marked.js; runs in browser.

title: Unix timestamp converter
description: Convert Unix timestamp (seconds or ms) to human date, or date to Unix. “Now” fills current time.

title: Hex ↔ RGB color converter
description: Convert hex ↔ RGB with live swatch preview. Privacy-first, no upload.

title: Lorem Ipsum generator
description: Generate paragraphs, sentences, or words of Lorem Ipsum for mockups.

title: Clock (embeddable)
description: Full analog + digital, or tiny embed ?tiny=1 for 100×50 iframes. Theme and TZ via URL.

title: Hash generator
description: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 from text or file. Copy hex, privacy-first.

title: Regex tester
description: Test regex pattern + flags against text. Live highlighting, groups, replace preview.

title: Diff checker
description: Compare two texts line-by-line. Added/removed highlighting with stats.

title: JWT decoder
description: Decode JWT header/payload, pretty JSON, expiry check. No verify, no upload.

title: QR generator
description: Text/URL → QR code. Size, error correction, download PNG. Offline fallback.

title: Password generator
description: Secure random passwords via crypto.getRandomValues. Entropy meter, bulk 5, copy.

title: Opencode Model Viewer — live
description: Live viewer for 567 opencode provider/model ids: current + fallback chain, live dots, search & copy. Zero-build.

title: Next.js tool suite (camera, audio, signature)
description: Next.js shell: camera test, signature pad, delayed audio, stereo channel verification at other.uft1.com.
